bullets.label: Closest match
bullets.text: Nothing in the inventory fills in proposals today.

bullets.label: Information
bullets.text: Customer details and deal pricing, including discounts. A security check is needed.

bullets.label: Main risk
bullets.text: Prices read from free-form notes could be wrong or out of date, and a wrong price in a sent proposal is hard to walk back.

bullets.label: Worth asking
bullets.text: Would it work if the tool pulled prices from the price sheet and used the notes only for seat counts and terms?

approve_with_limits.reason: Approved with one limit. Drafting proposals from deal notes saves time, but a wrong price is hard to take back. The tool must take every price from the price sheet instead of your notes.
approve_with_limits.what_would_change: If the price sheet gets an approved way to record custom discounts, we can look at letting the tool fill those in too.
